demoNotice: Demo checklist — not a verified Form 1083 mapping.

sourceConfirmation.notes: Illustrative demo catalog. Public-only source: LAHSA FY22-23 Form 1083 (footer 12-19-22, lahsa.org/item.ashx?id=6886, accessed 2026-10-28); selection docs/ITEM_SELECTION.md #4, #5, #8, #11a mapped to demo-* IDs. Seven reserved placeholders demo-item-05..11 added 2026-10-28; official wording, physical tests, and sign-offs TBD. No provider has confirmed an operative Form 1083 copy, version, wording, or physical-test requirements. Missing confirmation never promotes a demo item (see docs/integration/FORM_1083_MAPPING.md §1.2).

items.label: Interior air — window / fan / A/C (illustrative)
items.captureGuidance: Photograph the window, fan, or A/C unit in place, whole fixture visible, no people or identifying views.

manualChecks.instruction: Operate the window / switch the fan or A/C on and confirm airflow or function by feel or sound. A photograph cannot establish airflow or that the unit runs.

items.label: Water supply — faucets and flow (illustrative)
items.captureGuidance: Stand back 1–2 meters; photograph the faucet/basin in one frame, no people or identifying items.

manualChecks.instruction: Run the taps, confirm hot water and clear steady flow and drainage. A photograph cannot establish water flow, temperature, or drainage.

items.label: Lighting and electricity (illustrative)
items.captureGuidance: Photograph the room's light source(s) and outlet(s) with lights on, fixtures only, no people.

manualChecks.instruction: Operate switches/lights and confirm outlets power a test lamp. A photograph cannot establish that lights or outlets work.

items.label: Smoke + CO detectors (illustrative)
items.captureGuidance: Photograph each detector unit in place from directly below; do not touch or remove the unit for the photo.

manualChecks.instruction: Press the test button on each unit and confirm the alarm sounds. A photograph cannot establish that an alarm works.

manualChecks.instruction: Perform the in-person check for this area per worker procedure and confirm by direct observation. A photograph cannot establish the physical condition. Official requirement TBD.
